headline: EBITDA beat led by operational & commercial gains

highlights: Consequently, reported PAT stood at INR12.4bn (PLe: INR10.7bn; BBGe: INR11.0bn), up 9.1% QoQ and 53.3% YoY, supported by higher EBITDA and lower D&A and interest expenses.
Total volumes increased 11.6% QoQ and 1.3% YoY to 231Tbtu, with the mix remaining skewed towards 3rd-party volumes amid Qatar's force majeure.
EBITDA above estimates: Reported EBITDA came in above estimates at INR16.6bn (PLe: INR14.5bn; BBGe: INR15.1bn), up 8.6% QoQ and 48.9% YoY.
EBITDA includes operational and commercial efficiency gains (erstwhile trading/inventory gains) of INR6.6bn in Q2FY27 vs.
